records.text: From 2005 through 2012, Erika Kirk participated in beauty pageants every year Candace Owens could document
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Every single year from 2005 through 2012, Erika (Erika Kirk) was involved in beauty pageants. So that's seven years of her life that we could find. ... There could be more.

verification.notes: Current biographies and pageant histories document National American Miss participation followed by Miss Colorado USA and Miss Arizona USA competitions across much of 2007-2012. They do not establish participation in every calendar year beginning in 2005, and pageant-cycle dates can differ from title years.

sources.title: Erika Kirk pageant chronology
sources.relevance: Detailed chronology documents Miss Colorado USA and Miss Arizona USA participation across multiple title years.

records.text: During the 2005-2006 school year Erika Kirk was a Notre Dame Prep junior and first runner-up in National American Miss Arizona, qualifying for the November 2005 All-American Miss pageant
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Anyway, let's jump into an Erika (Erika Kirk) timeline and you guys can follow along here. 2005, Erika (Erika Kirk) is still attending Notre Dame Prep and she is playing basketball. ... She was a junior in high school from 2005-2006. She is going to win first runner-up in the National American Miss Arizona pageant, and she will represent Arizona in the upcoming All-American Miss pageant in November of 2005, which takes place in Los Angeles.

verification.notes: Current biographical and pageant searches corroborate later National American Miss participation but did not locate authoritative results for the precise 2005-06 first-runner-up placement and November 2005 All-American qualification asserted here.

records.text: In August 2006 Erika Kirk won a National American Miss Teen title and traveled to Washington to present plans to Representative J. D. Hayworth and Senator Jon Kyl
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: In August, just ahead of Erika (Erika Kirk)'s senior year, this is 2006 now, in August just ahead of her senior year, she's going to win the National American Miss Teen pageant and she wins a chance and takes it to travel to D.C. ... to present her plans to Representative J.D. Hayworth and Senator Jon Kyl.

verification.notes: Regis and current biographical sources support a National American Miss Teen Arizona title and a Presidential Classroom trip to Washington, D.C. However, current reporting places the title in 2007 rather than August 2006, and the reviewed sources do not confirm that her plans were personally presented to both J.D. Hayworth and Jon Kyl.
